title: ChamferFeature
description: Parametric Chamfer feature: bevels selected edges with a given distance (equal-distance style). Stub implementation stores intent; full mesh bevel is deferred. Intended for manufacturing (edge breaking, tool access, aesthetics).

distance.description: Chamfer distance (equal-distance mode): numeric value or parameter name / expression string. Positive.

edges.description: Optional list of edge identifiers or mesh edge indices to chamfer. Empty or omitted means all edges (or deferred selection).

operation.description: Intent: modify the current solid by chamfering edges. Full Boolean-style application deferred.
